verdicts.title: N-quandles of links
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The fundamental quandle is a powerful invariant of knots and links, but it is difficult to describe in detail. Hoste and Shanahan gave a complete list of the knots and links which have finite $n$-quandles for some $n$. verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A relative simplicial complex is a collection of sets of the form $Δ\setminus Γ$, where $Γ\subset Δ$ are simplicial complexes.
